title: Remove obsolete Docker topologies and migrate every active consumer
description:
The repository exposes only the consolidated image and one-service Compose path, with no active reference to the removed split, CLI, or all-in-one contracts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: docker/Dockerfile.api, docker/Dockerfile.web, docker/Dockerfile.cli, docker/entrypoint.sh, docker/nginx.conf, and their obsolete runtime configuration are deleted after the replacement image passes smoke.
- [hard] REQ-02: docker-compose.yml defines one service that bind-mounts the caller's whole repository at /repo, exposes the server/web port, maps explicit JIT_UID:JIT_GID values to the effective container user, and uses neither a detached named data volume nor a CLI initialization service.
- [hard] REQ-03: scripts/test-podman.sh, scripts/validate-setup.sh, INSTALL.md, docs/how-to/deployment.md, and any active README Docker entry point use the supported image/repository-mount contract, show how JIT_UID and JIT_GID are derived from the repository owner, and explain the fixed 10001:10001 default and ownership prerequisite in the same change.
- [hard] REQ-04: A repository-wide search over tracked active files, examples, and fixtures finds no split image names, removed Dockerfile/entrypoint/nginx paths, CLI Docker service, old all-in-one process contract, or Docker /data volume instruction; dev/archive and incidental storage-test /data strings are explicitly excluded.

## Notes

Blast radius: active Docker definitions, workflows, scripts, fixtures, and adopter-facing documentation; archive evidence is not rewritten.
